purpose: UX-02/UX-03 T06-T07: preserve unknown registration mutation identity and separate registration status transport state from validated business state.
ownerSpecification: Прозрачная Цена — инженерное ТЗ быстрого UX-ремонта v2.0, 23.09.2026, sections 3.1, 3.3, 3.4 and UX-02/UX-03 T06/T07.
coordination: Team Hub #5469 claim 5786100911. No overlap with #5538 contact, #5536 market, Claude #5537 Gekta or seller/Founder work.
requiredInvariants: A browser/network timeout or BFF upstream transport loss never claims the registration was rejected; it produces an explicit unknown UI outcome.
Unknown operation preserves the exact serialized payload and idempotency key. Same payload reuses that key; changed payload creates a new operation/key.
A synchronous submit ref prevents duplicate mutation before the first await; React state is not the concurrency authority.
Status loading, unavailable and invalid/expired are UI states separate from business status. No token-only path defaults to EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED or VERIFY_EMAIL.
Business registration status and next action render only after allowlisted validation of the received server payload.
No role, tenant, auth, database, API backend, mail provider, release workflow or CI threshold changes.
